F1: canManage()` at `GroupPermissionsV2.java:70` accepts the `VIEW` scope, so an admin with view-only access to all groups passes `requireManage()` in `addTopLevelGroup`, which can create groups and move them to the top level.
F2: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission` returns authorization resource IDs, not group IDs; per-group resources carry the group ID in their name and have no `Groups` type, so they are never enumerated and the group-scoped user count comes out wrong.
